verdict.rationale: Raygun's own AI Error Resolution feature offers an in-product chat (raygun-docs-5, raygun-docs-27, raygun-docs-32) for asking about root causes and fixes, and an official MCP server exists (raygun-probe-3) that could expose the product to natural-language agents. However, the chat only covers diagnosis, not operating the product (e.g., resolving, ignoring, filtering or exporting errors), and the MCP server's tool scope is not documented in the evidence. Missing for 10: documented natural-language control of product operations (triage, status changes, filtering, exports); documented MCP tool coverage; independent or hands-on corroboration.
